title: Quality, Not Just Outcome: A Structural Scoring Framework for Selecting Coding-Agent Trajectories for Supervised Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.13152v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Open coding agents are commonly trained through supervised fine-tuning on interaction trajectories whose final patches pass the benchmark test suite. However, this outcome-level filtering criterion ignores process quality: trajectories that eventually succeed may still contain inefficient interaction patterns such as repetitive file inspection, unstable tool usage, or delayed modification behavior, all of which become part of the imitation target. We propose TQS (Trajectory Quality Score), a structural scoring framework for coding-agent trajectories that operates directly on trajectory structure, requires no LLM judge, and runs in linear time. TQS characterizes trajectory quality through structural signals organized around structured convergence: information focus, intent--action alignment, and policy dynamics. Using 155,144 successful trajectories from a public open-license corpus, we rank trajectories by TQS and fine-tune coding agents

translated_title: 质量，而不仅仅是结果：用于选择编程智能体轨迹进行监督微调的结构化评分框架
translated_abstract: 开放编程智能体通常通过监督微调进行训练，其使用的交互轨迹需满足最终补丁通过基准测试套件的条件。然而，这种结果层面的过滤标准忽略了过程质量：最终成功的轨迹可能仍包含低效的交互模式，例如重复的文件检查、不稳定的工具使用或延迟的修改行为，而这些都会成为模仿目标的一部分。我们提出了TQS（轨迹质量分数，Trajectory Quality Score），一个针对编程智能体轨迹的结构化评分框架，它直接作用于轨迹结构，无需LLM评判者，并以线性时间运行。TQS通过围绕“结构化收敛”组织的结构化信号来刻画轨迹质量：信息聚焦、意图-行动对齐以及策略动态。利用来自公开开放许可语料库的155,144条成功轨迹，我们根据TQS对轨迹进行排序并微调编程智能体。
tldr: 提出TQS轨迹质量评分框架，直接基于轨迹结构评估过程质量，无需LLM评判且线性时间运行，用于筛选高质量编程智能体轨迹以提升监督微调效果。
en_tdlr: TQS is a structural scoring framework that assesses the process quality of coding-agent trajectories directly from their structure—requiring no LLM judge and running in linear time—to select higher-quality trajectories for supervised fine-tuning.
